messages:
maria: quick thought — can we fold per-route + per-model filter state into saved queries? currently users have to duplicate the same filter across route view and model view, which is annoying :thinking:
ashok: are you thinking about a single savedquery object that carries a scope flag (route|model|both) and the exact filter DSL?
maria: exactly. scope flag + a binding to route id and optional model id. UI would show a little pill: "bound to route: payments" or "shared"
jules: UX caution: if a saved query is bound to a route and we rollout model pinning, what happens when the route switches default model? do we want the saved query to follow the default or be pinned to the explicit model id?
maria: probably explicit model id by default, but have a toggle in the editor: [follow route default]. that would help canary deploys and rollouts.
pm-el: also think about telemetry: we need to record which scope users select and when a savedquery resolves to a different model than expected. would love a small event schema for "saved_query_applied" that includes scope, route_id, model_id_resolved
randall: agree on telemetry. quota-wise, saved queries should be free to create but execution counts against route query execs. if a team pins heavy queries they can trigger quota alerts. maybe show a preview cost estimate when saving?
jules: preview cost estimate is nice, but we need to avoid FUD — it should be a range (p50/p90 tokens) and tie into the route's telemetry for average seq len
maria: proposal for UI flows: 
- create saved query -> choose scope (route/model/both)
- if route bound, show "follow route default" checkbox
- show preview sample with estimated cost + recent hit rate
- in saved query list, show badge: "route:payments" or "model:xlarge-v2 (pinned)"
ashok: implementation note: backend saved_query object fields: name, owner, scope, route_id?, model_id?, filter_expr (string), pinned_follow_flag(boolean), meta_last_applied_ts, meta_last_resolved_model
jules: careful: agents.md requires no nested JSON — but that's internal. For storage, we can store meta as flat keys. in our API response we can expand.
pm-el: rollout UX: when we change route default model, offer an admin prompt: "Some saved queries bound to this route are pinned to the previous default model. Update them to follow the new default?" with an audit log.
randall: +1 on audit log. ops will ask for a dry-run mode to preview what changes would be applied.
maria: edgecases: shared saved queries across teams with different access to models. need auth check when resolving model_id — fallback to nearest compatible model and surface that in UI with :eyes:
ashok: API debate: should we resolve model_id at save-time (store resolved_model) or at apply-time? applying-time gives up-to-date behavior but is non-idempotent.
jules: prefer apply-time with a cached resolved_model for display and telemetry. add ttl on cache so we don't confuse users.
pm-el: telemetry events to add: saved_query_created, saved_query_applied, saved_query_resolved_model_change, saved_query_follow_toggle
maria: next steps: design mocks for the editor (I'll sketch), infra will spec the API fields (ashok + randall), pm will write the telemetry event contract (npm-el). Can we sync tomorrow 10am? :calendar:
ashok: 10am works for me. I'll draft a minimal API proto and share in thread before the sync.
jules: pinging @pm_elaine to confirm product priority
pm_elaine: pls add to roadmap board. this helps with console adoption. putting it at priority P2 for now. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder: console service deploy at 6pm UTC — saved_query api changes require schema migrations, schedule after migration window. (reacted :warning:)
maria: noted, we'll coordinate migrations with eng-releases. thanks everyone!
